newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gemex's COO to return to PepsiCo.
newsitem.headline: Gemex's COO to return to PepsiCo.

text.p: Mexican bottling company Grupo Embotellador de Mexico S.A. de C.V. said on Monday its Chief Operating Officer Steve Lawrence will return to PepsiCo to become president of PepsiCola Mexicana.

Lawrence will continue as COO of Gemex, as the company is known, during a transition period and will actively participate on the Company's Executive Committee and Board of Director, Gemex said in a statement.

"Steve contributed significantly to our success during the past year and we regret his departure," said Enrique Molina, Chairman of the Board of Gemex. "However, we view Steve's new post as a strategic move to reaffirm Pepsi's key market position in Mexico."
Molina said he has been actively interviewing a pool of candidates for the job.
As an anchor bottler in Mexico for PepsiCo, Gemex's operations encompass the huge Mexico City market and portions of 11 other Mexican states.
